title: Business Breakfast | Stock/Share Market News | 10th August 2026 || TV5 Money

recommendations.note: Extremely good, excellent result. Will definitely raise the curtain on a fresh rally again -- that has to be watched.
recommendations.detail: Speaking by telephone before catching a flight, Kutumba Rao said individual stock specific action will dominate because the opportunities are all results based, including even the big frontline stocks. He cited Hindalco as his example: the result was extremely good, excellent, so a company like Hindalco will definitely now again raise the curtain on a fresh rally, and that has to be watched.

recommendations.note: Delivery buying with conviction seen. Buy on declines; a cross of 86.25 opens an attempt towards 90 plus.
recommendations.detail: In his flow readout Kutumba Rao listed IDFC First Bank among the counters showing delivery buying with conviction, alongside Coal India, Chola Finance and Oberoi Realty. He said the stock has been consolidating at 85 for many days and that once 86.25, the 85-86 area, is crossed, signs of an attempt to go to 90 plus are clearly visible, so he would say buy on declines.
